annotations.title: Read tourism totals of an Italian region, province or Italy

description: Reads the tourism totals of one Italian region, one province or the whole of Italy in one year: nights, arrivals, bed places, establishments and population. Use it for the figures of a whole territory, split by guests resident in Italy and abroad; do not use it to rank or filter territories (use classifica_territori instead) or for a single comune (use leggi_dati_comune instead). Names ignore case and accents, Trentino-Alto Adige is one region with the provinces of Bolzano and Trento, and an unknown name returns an error with the closest names (elenca_territori lists them all). The totals are those of classifica_territori for the same year; a figure that is not available is null and `nota` says why, also from 2025, when the counts changed scope. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

anno.description: Year of the figures, e.g. 2024; default: the latest year with data. A year outside the years with data returns an error that gives them.

livello.description: What to total: "regione" (one region), "provincia" (one province) or "nazione" (the whole of Italy, the sum of the regions).

nome.description: Italian name of the region or province, in any case ("Toscana", "Bolzano", "Monza e Brianza"); required for regione and provincia, omitted for nazione.

name: leggi_dati_territorio

anno.description: Year of the figures: the requested one, or the latest year with data; null only when no figures are loaded.

arrivi_italiani.description: Arrivals of guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_stranieri.description: Arrivals of guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

arrivi_totali.description: Guest arrivals (check-ins) at accommodation establishments during `anno`; null if not available.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

livello.description: Kind of territory, as requested: "regione", "provincia" or "nazione" (the whole of Italy).

n_comuni.description: Number of comuni of the territory, as counted by elenca_territori.

n_comuni_con_dati.description: How many of those comuni have movement figures of their own in `anno`.

n_esercizi.description: Accommodation establishments in `anno` of the same comuni, the total of classifica_territori; null if not available.

nome.description: Name of the region or province as recorded by ISTAT (in capitals), the one `nome` resolved to; null for nazione.

nota.description: Notes in English on reading the totals, null when there is nothing to say: from 2025 ISTAT counts include privately rented holiday flats, so totals and non-hotel figures are not comparable with years before 2025 (hotel figures are); ISTAT rows that group the small comuni of a province, counted in the totals; a territory without figures in `anno`.

popolazione.description: Resident population in `popolazione_anno`, summed over the comuni of the territory; null if not available.

popolazione_anno.description: Reference year of `popolazione`: the latest year loaded; null if not available.

posti_letto.description: Bed places in `anno` of the comuni with movement figures in `anno`, the total of classifica_territori; null if not available.

presenze_italiani.description: Nights spent by guests resident in Italy during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_stranieri.description: Nights spent by guests resident abroad during `anno`; null if not available.

presenze_totali.description: Nights spent by all guests in accommodation establishments during `anno` (one guest staying three nights counts three); null if not available.

regione.description: Region of the province, or the region itself (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null for nazione.

title: Read tourism totals of an Italian region, province or Italy
